Natumba ang siklista; masakit at deformed ang braso
Nakapagsasalita siya at gustong ituwid ang braso
display_en:
A cyclist fell; her forearm is painful and deformed
She can speak and wants the arm pulled straight
narration_fil: Natumba ang siklista at masakit at deformed ang kanyang braso. Nakapagsasalita siya at gustong hilahin ang braso para maituwid.
narration_en: A cyclist fell and now has a painful, deformed forearm. She can speak and wants the arm pulled straight.

display_fil:
Iwasan ang hindi kailangang galaw
Suportahan ang bahaging nasugatan sa posisyong nakita
Ayusin ang pagsusuri; tingnan ang iba pang agarang problema
Sundin ang sanay/lokal na tagubilin sa immobilization at paglipat
display_en:
Avoid unnecessary movement
Support the injured part in the position found
Arrange prompt assessment; check for other urgent concerns
Follow trained/local instructions for immobilization and transfer
narration_fil: Iwasan ang hindi kailangang galaw. Suportahan ang bahaging nasugatan sa posisyong nakita at ayusin ang agarang pagsusuri. Tingnan kung may iba pang agarang problema. Sundin ang sanay o lokal na tagubilin sa immobilization at paglipat.
narration_en: Avoid unnecessary movement. Support the injured part in the position found and arrange prompt assessment. Check for other urgent concerns and follow trained/local instructions for immobilization and transfer.

Ano ang unang tugon?

display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Masakit at deformed ang braso ng siklista. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: The cyclist's forearm is painful and deformed. What do you do first?

options.fil: Suportahan ang braso sa posisyong nakita.
options.en: Support the arm in the position you found it.

options.fil: Hilahin nang dahan-dahan ang braso gaya ng hiling niya.
options.en: Pull the arm straight gently, as the cyclist asks.

options.fil: Masahihin ang braso para gumaan bago tumawag.
options.en: Massage the arm to ease the pain before calling.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Iwasan ang hindi kailangang galaw at suportahan ang braso sa posisyong nakita. 2: Huwag ituwid ang deformity kahit hilingin ng tao. Suportahan ito sa posisyong nakita. 3: Huwag itong masahihin. Suportahan sa posisyon at ayusin ang agarang pagsusuri.
check.feedback_en: 1: Correct. Avoid unnecessary movement and support the injured part in the position found. 2: Do not straighten a deformity, even if the person asks. Support it as found. 3: Do not massage it. Support it in place and arrange prompt assessment.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Sinusuportahan ni Lea ang braso sa posisyong nakita
Ipinaliliwanag niya kung bakit hindi ito itutuwid
Tinitingnan niya ang iba pang agarang problema
Tumatawag siya sa kumpirmadong contact
display_en:
Lea supports the forearm where she found it
She explains why she will not pull it straight
She checks for other urgent concerns
She calls the confirmed contact for assessment
narration_fil: Pinapanatili ni Lea na hindi gumagalaw ang siklista at sinusuportahan ang braso sa posisyong nakita. Nakiusap ang siklista na hilahin ito para maituwid. Ipinaliwanag ni Lea na hindi niya ito itutuwid at iiwasan ang hindi kailangang galaw. Tiningnan niya kung may iba pang agarang problema. Saka niya tinawagan ang kumpirmadong contact para sa agarang pagsusuri.
narration_en: Lea asks the cyclist to keep still and supports the forearm in the position she found it. When the cyclist asks her to pull it straight, Lea explains that she will not straighten it and will avoid unnecessary movement. She checks for other urgent concerns. Then she calls the confirmed contact for prompt assessment.

display_fil:
Huwag ituwid o imasahe ang deformity
Walang improvised na splint na walang padding kung hindi sanay
Huwag ilipat ang posibleng may spinal injury, maliban sa kaligtasan
display_en:
Do not straighten a deformity or massage it
No unpadded improvised splint without training
Do not move a possible spinal injury unless safety demands it
narration_fil: Huwag ituwid o imasahe ang deformity. Huwag gumamit ng improvised na splint na walang padding kung hindi sanay. Huwag ilipat ang posibleng may spinal injury maliban kung kailangan sa kaligtasan.
narration_en: Do not straighten a deformity, massage it, use an unpadded improvised splint without training, or move a person with possible spinal injury unless safety demands it.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Suportado na ang braso. Ano pa ang gagawin mo bago dumating ang tulong?
check.prompt_en: The arm is supported. What else do you do before help arrives?

options.fil: Itali ang patpat bilang splint at pauwiin siyang nakabisikleta.
options.en: Tie a stick to the arm as a splint and let her ride home.

options.fil: Tingnan ang iba pang agarang problema at tumawag.
options.en: Check for other urgent concerns and make the call.

options.fil: Sabihing bugbog lang iyon at puwede na siyang umuwi.
options.en: Tell her it is only a bruise and she can go home.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag gumamit ng improvised na splint na walang padding kung hindi sanay; kailangan pa rin niya ng agarang pagsusuri. 2: Tama. Tingnan ang iba pang agarang problema at ayusin ang agarang pagsusuri. Sanay o lokal na tagubilin ang susundin sa immobilization at paglipat. 3: Hindi nagdi-diagnose ang BHW ng pinsala. Ayusin ang agarang pagsusuri.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not use an unpadded improvised splint without training; she still needs prompt assessment. 2: Correct. Check for other urgent concerns and arrange prompt assessment; trained/local instructions guide immobilization and transfer. 3: A BHW does not diagnose the injury. Arrange prompt assessment.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, gamitin ang kaparehong checklist sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso. Itala ang nakita at kung sino ang tatawagan. Gumamit ng props para ipakita ang suporta sa posisyon, ipaliwanag ang panganib ng paggalaw at tumawag.
narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. Use a prop to show support in place, explain when movement is unsafe and make the referral call.
